intent: Commit the entire paired evaluation policy in a separate V2 profile already covered by original T; require exact later Cell/Product reconstruction and independent raw metadata verification. Never upgrade legacy V1 signatures or infer execution authority.

fixed_before_T: original rule canonical digest, task, snapshot and original ledger identity
complete Product Context/Input: plan, objective, claim scope, baseline participant, base estimand, all metrics/directions/floors, role kinds and margins, all metric sources
both complete Temporal plans, original alpha/comparison counts, W and support/confidence thresholds, final holdout identity
every complete CrossFold partition, all lineage sets and original model/prediction digest declarations
full comparison capacity/cumulative/update policy, baseline receipt reference, full cost coverage and metering digest
complete real pair input/protocol, original principal, distinct ledger-derived episode/run/decision identities
primary and every nonempty retention member; full registration determines request.evaluation_profile
only_late_slots: unique actual original signed-T candidate identity and bundle; original T receipt payload digest
actual Dataset/holdout manifest from the original authenticated completed cohort
two actual original Cell records and their physical structures; deterministic original Cell estimand recomputed from complete fixed+observed record
no_late_slots: W/alpha/comparison count/metric source/role/margin/claim scope/base estimand/fold metadata
new principals or renamed arms, targets, outcomes or ledger identities
policy.time_claim: Original T signature on the exact V2 panel profile cryptographically commits the full preimage before existing original B window checks. It does not prove V2 was parsed by T then or a factory ran before A.
policy.cross_fold_limit: Existing fold digests are fixed commitments. This change does not turn metadata commitments into proof of actual fitting or predict future admission timestamps.
policy.ordinary_claim_scope: New ordinary Panel declaration accepts only Qualification, already supported by original E holdout material. Pure Product metadata retains its prior legal modes.
policy.compatibility: Legacy Shared code and paired V1 canonical/signature bytes remain. Legacy paired V1 is readable but has no V2 release or Model/Selector adoption eligibility.
policy.remote: Complete policy appended once per member in V2 current; strict decode and raw expected commitments compare complete plan/estimand/roles. No remote FrozenPlan/Execution/Qualification seal is constructed.
policy.eligibility: Original member/cohort authentication and retention-set checks occur first. qualified also requires every member policy_bound; original signed primary observation still reflects only its primary verdict.
policy.authority: Metadata only; no new grant/key/policy, signer, capability, reconnect, deadline extension or cross-request CURRENT cache. Existing actual B task/inference custody remains necessary.

sequence: decision: read.id()?, principal: read.id()?, episode: read.id()?, run: read.id()?

required: same exact original cohort and signatures
